issues.title: [26.1.2] "Could not load default style" on client setup: GuiStyle.reload() runs before resources are loaded
issues.body:
**Versions**
- CreativeCore 2.14.16 (CreativeCore_NEOFORGE_v2.14.16_mc26.1.2.jar)
- Minecraft 26.1.2, NeoForge 26.1.2.122, Java 25.0.4

**Issue**
On every client start, CreativeCore logs:

```
[08:55:52] [modloading-worker-0/ERROR]: java.util.NoSuchElementException: No value present
[08:55:52] [modloading-worker-0/ERROR]: Could not load default style
[08:55:52] [modloading-worker-0/INFO]: Client setup complete.
...
[08:55:54] [Render thread/INFO]: Reloading ResourceManager: ...
```

**Likely cause**
`GuiStyle.reload()` does `mc.getResourceManager().getResource(GuiStyleUtils.DEFAULT_STYLE_LOCATION).orElseThrow()` (`creativecore:gui/default_style.json`). It is called during client setup (08:55:52), before the first resource reload (08:55:54), so the resource manager does not contain mod resources yet and `orElseThrow()` throws. The file itself is present in the jar (`assets/creativecore/gui/default_style.json`).

**Expected**
Load the default style from a reload listener (after resources are available), or skip the early call, so no ERROR is logged. I have not seen a visible GUI problem, so the style is probably loaded again later; this is mostly a misleading ERROR in the log.

Heads up, I've been getting a couple issue reports recently with Kilt 1.20.1 that is caused by CreativeCore using a slightly older version of EventBus (6.0.3 vs [6.2.33](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/eventbus/index.html), check the "Show all Versions" dropdown, ignore EventBus 7 since that's massive breaking changes), because the EventBus version on Kilt recently got updated - https://github.com/KiltMC/Kilt/issues/998#issuecomment-5545631253

The main reason why this is even a problem in the first place is largely because Kilt uses a [custom fork of EventBus](https://github.com/KiltMC/EventBus) specifically for disabling ModLauncher interaction. Previously, I would just use Fabric-ASM to [directly override the classes that this fork modifies](https://github.com/KiltMC/Kilt/blob/version/1.20.1/src/main/kotlin/xyz/bluspring/kilt/loader/asm/KiltEarlyRiser.kt#L404-L434), but since this is a new API addition to EventBus, it's VERY likely I would have to override a lot of the classes, which I don't really want to do.

[Bug] Server crash in SoundConfig due to missing null/validity check on ResourceLocation (PlayerRevive)
issues.body:
## Description
I have identified a critical issue in `CreativeCore` (specifically used by `PlayerRevive`) where the server crashes if the `SoundConfig`'s `ResourceLocation` is empty or invalid. While an empty sound string might be saved as `"minecraft:"` in the config, the current implementation fails to validate the registry lookup, leading to a crash in specific death scenarios.

I am reporting this here because `CreativeCore` is a dependency for multiple mods, and this lack of validation in the premade `SoundConfig` class could affect any mod using it.

## The Logic Issue

In `team.creative.creativecore.common.config.premade.SoundConfig`, the `play` method calls `BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(event)` without checking if the result is null before passing it to `playSound`.

### Steps to Reproduce / Test Results (Dedicated Server)
The crash is specifically tied to how the player dies.

| Scenario | Result |
| :--- | :--- |
| Player is killed by another player while downed | Log spam (Error), but **no crash** |
| A player falls into the void, but manually **"Gives Up"** (Left-click/Self-terminate) | Log spam (Error), but **no crash** |
| **A player falls into the void and is killed by void damage** | **NullPointerException (Crash)** |
| **Player dies automatically due to timeout while downed** | **ServerHangWatchdog (Crash)** |

### Config context:
Users might naturally leave the sound path empty or use an invalid string intending to "disable" the sound. While adding a boolean toggle or checking for empty strings is a common way to "turn off" a feature, the code should nonetheless perform a safety check to prevent a total server collapse.

## Source Code Reference:
[SoundConfig.java](https://github.com/CreativeMD/CreativeCore/blob/1.20/src/main/java/team/creative/creativecore/common/config/premade/SoundConfig.java)

```java
public void play(Entity entity, SoundSource category) {
    // If 'event' is invalid/empty, get() returns null, causing NPE in playSound
    entity.level().playSound(null, entity, BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(event), category, volume, pitch);
}
```

issues.body:
Hi, I am the developer of Kilt, a mod designed to load Forge mods in Fabric. Essentially, think of the Connector mod but for Fabric -> Forge.

Unfortunately, CreativeCore's Fabric build is entirely incompatible with Kilt due to incredibly simplified versions of Forge's classes being included in CreativeCore, and in most cases, CreativeCore's Forge classes will end up loading first before Kilt's even has a chance, thus causing a crash on any Forge mods that try to access any Forge methods that aren't implemented in CreativeCore.

I wanted to know and work with you on what could be done in order to bypass this issue. A few ideas I have for what Kilt could do:
- Try to figure out how to load Kilt's Forge classes before CreativeCore does
- Overwrite CreativeCore's Forge classes with Kilt's via Fabric-ASM (*really* don't want to do this, but it's something I can do)
- Separate classloader system for Forge mods specifically (not something I want to do, I feel like this could ultimately have its own issues)

issues.title: Enable old Rendering for 1.12.2
issues.body:
Good Morning,

I would like to ask if there could be some setting to (optionally) enable the old rendering system from CreativeCore_v1.9.45_mc1.12.2 and older in the newest CreateCore Version.

It is such a pitty that shadows look so much better in the older version than in the newer ones. 

In 1.21 this seems to be better, but unfortunatelly so many mods are still not compatible to that version.

The reason why I ask for this is, that some user already made a modification of the newest CreativeCore, which has much better shadows, but unfortunatelly still not the same quality level like the older version mentioned above. So it seems like there is some technical way to (easily?) manipulate the rendering.


Versions that have good looking shadows:
CreativeCore_v1.9.45_mc1.12.2
LittleTiles_v1.5.0-pre135_mc1.12.2

issues.title: Change to a different CurseForge gradle plugin
issues.body:
**OVERVIEW**
the task used by creativecore (and other mods) is archived and had missing the capability of set "side versioning"
this is important and helps users to rid off bloat mods from server when only had funtionality on client-side (like AmbientSounds)

**SOLUTION**
Replace CurseGradle with [CurseForgeGradle (by Darkhax)](https://github.com/Darkhax/CurseForgeGradle)
implementation on the upload task is basically [the same](https://github.com/SrRapero720/waterframes/blob/fbed42abda531f5ec35a61c0e50de82cee927c1c/build.gradle#L153-L169) so it can work without break the buildscript, and it can contain the side version `mainFile.addGameVersion(mcversion, "server", "client")`

and doesn't require the patch on the old task when the CF key is null

issues.title: Suggestions in GuiSliders on Right-click
issues.body:
**OVERVIEW**
Sliders are in-range value pickers, when you right click the slider it let you choose a specific value in that range
In the past it only shows the float value in the specific range, but the PR #207 adds the DisplayValue, which is a fake value display such as PERCENT, this display ignores if the max value is 125 or 215, it always shows the percent when value is between 0 to 100, if the value overflows then the percent also overflows.

this makes users have no idea of what should put inside the TextField when they right-click the sliders

**SOLUTION**
When user right-clicks the slider, the TextField will be created with a suggestion (also fixed in ff43f2f94028c3f9fdfcdda962c8ae6834827a58) displaying the range of the real values
example: `range of -85 ~ 255` or `0 ~ 255` or `0.0 to 1.0`

issues.title: Use 'fabric-api' mod ID in fabric.mod.json
issues.body:
Users may be confused when they see that it depends on `fabric`, not knowing that it's referring to the Fabric API. 

>As of Minecraft 1.19.2, Fabric API's mod ID has changed from `fabric` to `fabric-api`. When backporting from 1.19.2 to earlier versions, you must alter the `depends` section of your `fabric.mod.json` to expect `fabric`.

issues.title: Mods for Minecraft 1.17.x require additional changes for compatibility
issues.body:
**FYI:** Mostly a reminder than issue since these files are often forgotten to be updated.  There are files to change for 1.17.1 to work.
**mods.toml**, ***mixins*** and **pack.mcmeta** need updating for every major release of Minecraft depending on what is included.
Minecraft 1.17.x - Minimum Java Level Supported: 16.0.1
pack.mcmeta files Pack Format=7 for 1.17.x release, 6 for 1.16 and 5 for 1.15, etc.
Minecraft Vanilla Launcher (new one from Microsoft Store) has loading issues that require additional changes to our mods and modpacks.  Read conversation towards the bottom on Forge Support: https://forums.minecraftforge.net/topic/105079-forge-1171-not-launching/?_fromLogin=1
This describes how to workaround the breaking change Microsoft made with the new Vanilla Minecraft launcher.  I'm posting here as I've looked at this 1.17.x version of the mod and found one or both issues exist.  It wasn't an easy process figuring out why mods were not working properly so I've provided the data so you don't have to waste time trying to figure out why.

issues.title: Netty ByteBuf leak?
issues.body:
Came from https://www.mcbbs.net/thread-1179223-1-1.html which posted this log: https://paste.ubuntu.com/p/xZn3DJ2fBx/

Judging by the stack trace I assume it is 1.12.2. Problematic line:

https://github.com/CreativeMD/CreativeCore/blob/f544f061fef75ed4c2de2a3f01e4a8a6f8f44f72/src/main/java/com/creativemd/creativecore/common/config/sync/ConfigurationPacket.java#L36

According to the log message, it is suggested to add 
```java
buf.release();
```
at the end of the `writeBytes(ByteBuf)`, to avoid potential memory leak.

Further reading:
https://netty.io/wiki/reference-counted-objects.html

issues.title: Incompatibility with Optifine Shades / Betweenlands
issues.body:
### **Overview:** 

So Optifine has a feature with it shaders that allow for them to be enabled or disabled for certain dimensions using an empty folder called "world[Dimension ID]" This has worked brilliantly for other mods such as the Betweenlands, which carries its own shader. _However_, This seems to have been broken when using Creative Core, even without any of its subsidiaries.

### **Issue:** 

Normally with the setup mentioned, when using a portal, the shader switches from what Optifine is currently using to the one from the Betweenlands.

However, when Creative core is running, when you go through a portal, the screen freezes. The game is still running and audio, movement, and full control still are taking place in the game, but you can't see it, only the last frame before going through the portal.

### **How to Reproduce:** 

**1.** Run the latest versions of Forge (14.23.5.2838), Optifine, (1.12.2_HD_U_E3), the Betweenlands (v3.4.7), and Creative core (v1.9.45_mc1.12.2).

**2.** Use one of the following Shaders I linked below. You could use anyone from the internet, but you would have to add the "world[Dimension ID]" yourself.

[Shaders](https://github.com/CreativeMD/CreativeCore/files/3286548/Sildurs.Vibrant.Shaders.zip)

**3.** Launch the game and create a new world.

**4.** create a Betweenlands portal and attempt to go through.

**5.** Profit?

### **Conclusion:** 

If you have any questions about this, please let me know. I'm aware that this is a niche issue, but I hope it gets addressed soon. Thanks.

issues.title: Licensing issue
issues.body:
As per the MCP license, you're not allowed to distribute their data files without explicit permission from the MCP team.

As far as I understand, you're only using it to transform between Notch and SRG names - however, you can make your transformers load after the Notch->SRG transformation step by applying the "@IFMLLoadingPlugin.SortingIndex(1001)" annotation to your coremod's main class, ensuring you never have to deal with Notch names.
